accepted.originals: All five official pages were readable through the public web index. Original response bytes were unavailable in the research tool, so no checksum or byte count is claimed; this is an access/tooling limitation, not a reuse prohibition.

deferred.reason: Explicit website terms prohibit copying or incorporation into another work beyond personal-use exceptions. The staged candidate batch was withdrawn in full before publication.
Explicit copyright notice prohibits duplication, downloading, storage, publication and use absent express permission. No facts or bytes were imported.
